thread:
mike: quick heads-up — console shows p95 jump for /v1/complete in eu-west but p99 barely moved. p50 also stable. anyone else seeing mismatch by transport (grpc vs http)? noticed routing policy change last night.
sara: I saw that too, digging. sample counts look similar though. what's odd is the http bucket shifted right but grpc didn't.
anne: do we preserve transport in the rollup? console groups by endpoint only afaik, transport is metadata but not always preserved in rollups.
jeff: that's the crux — our rollup merges by route tag and drops lower-cardinality labels. transport was in the source but got collapsed in the composite rollup. so p95 could be dominated by a small http sub-cohort.
mike: ah — so p99 unchanged because that was driven by a different cohort (large kvcache misses on grpc). can we surface an attribution lens? maybe add transport as optional split in the latency pane.
sara: quick debug: query from metrics api
GET /metrics/latency?route=/v1/complete&quantiles=50,95,99&groupby=["transport"]&window=5m
return shows http p95 ~220ms (count 1200) grpc p95 ~90ms (count 18)

anne: that explains it — http is lower-volume but many more midtail hits. p99 dominated by grpc outliers but counts too small to move p95 for the combined.
jeff: options: (1) change rollup to keep transport as rollout-annotation for routes with >X variance, (2) surface small-cohort badge, (3) change default quantile blending to weight by cohort size. tradeoffs.
mike: my vote: show small-cohort warning + allow one-click split by transport. we don't want to explode cardinality by default.
sara: agree. I'll open a tiny console PR for a warning toast + quick-split action. anne can you add a backend flag to include transport in the rollup for flagged routes? jeff LMK if that design sounds sane.
jeff: sounds good. I'll sketch the rollup-annotation API: add annotations=["transport"] optional param and keep current default. Need to ensure storage doesn't double counts. also add a flag min_cohort_count.
metrics-bot: alert created: METRICS-7421 tracking p95 transport-attruation work — assignees sara, anne, jeff
mike: awesome, thanks. can we add a quick note in the rollout docs about this edge-case? small cohorts can skew pX when labels collapse.
sara: on it :spiral_calendar:
